previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for observation following a scheduled flexible bronchoscopy with balloon dilation of multi-level airway stenosis due to relapsing polychondritis and Ruvalcaba-Myhre-Smith syndrome. The procedure was completed without complications, and he remained hemodynamically stable throughout the admission, with oxygen saturations in the mid- to high-90s on 40% trach mask. Mild post-procedural pain was managed with analgesics. Bronchial washings showed Serratia marcescens and Proteus mirabilis, interpreted as colonizing flora rather than active infection. Biopsies were obtained and pending at discharge. A prednisone taper was prescribed to reduce inflammation, and he was discharged home with follow-up planned with interventional pulmonology in four weeks.
